update_log: Baseline initialization of high-frequency Articles of the Indian Constitution categorized by Parts for Polity Static GK.

fundamental_rights_and_duties.provision: Equality before the law and equal protection of laws.
Abolition of Untouchability and prohibition of its practice.
Protection of six rights regarding freedom of: (speech and expression, assembly, association, movement, residence, and profession).
Protection of life and personal liberty (No person shall be deprived of his life or personal liberty except according to procedure established by law).
Right to Education (Free and compulsory education to all children of the age of 6 to 14 years). Added by the 86th Amendment.
Right to Constitutional Remedies (Issuance of writs). Called the 'heart and soul of the Constitution' by Dr. B.R. Ambedkar.
Uniform Civil Code for the citizens throughout the territory of India.
Fundamental Duties of citizens. Added by the 42nd Amendment (Swaran Singh Committee).

union_executive_and_parliament.provision: The President of India (There shall be a President of India).
Procedure for impeachment of the President.
Power of President to grant pardons, reprieves, respites, or remissions of punishment.
Council of Ministers to aid and advise President.
Attorney-General for India (Highest law officer of the country).
Definition of 'Money Bills'. (Can only be introduced in the Lok Sabha).
Annual Financial Statement (Constitution does not use the word 'Budget').
Power of President to promulgate Ordinances during recess of Parliament.

judiciary_and_cag.provision: Establishment and constitution of the Supreme Court.
Supreme Court to be a court of record (Power to punish for its contempt).
Review of judgments or orders by the Supreme Court (Curative petition origin).
Power of President to consult the Supreme Court (Advisory jurisdiction).
Power of High Courts to issue certain writs.

constitutional_bodies_and_emergency.provision: Panchayats and Municipalities (Added by 73rd and 74th Amendments).
Consolidated Funds and public accounts of India and of the States.
Contingency Fund of India (Placed at the disposal of the President).
Finance Commission (Constituted by the President every fifth year).
Persons not to be deprived of property save by authority of law (Right to property - changed from a Fundamental Right to a Constitutional Right by 44th Amendment).
Public Service Commissions for the Union and for the States (UPSC & SPSC).
Superintendence, direction, and control of elections to be vested in an Election Commission.
Proclamation of Emergency (National Emergency on grounds of war, external aggression, or armed rebellion).
Provisions in case of failure of constitutional machinery in States (President's Rule / State Emergency).
Power of Parliament to amend the Constitution and procedure therefor.
